title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.67 (unsettled) at 01:00 UTC on 22 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日 01:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.67（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.67 (2M) at 01:00 UTC. The 01:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 01:59; hour-end 1.67/2M). The trailing 02:00 UTC hour is incomplete (9 samples through 02:08) and is not used for the headline. Last-180 maximum is 1.67 (first at 2026-09-22 01:00 UTC; label 2M; last-180 window from 23:09 UTC). Published-window maximum is 1.67 (01:00 UTC; label 2M). Window start 2026-09-21 20:11 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 1.67（2M），取樣 01:00 UTC。01:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 01:59，時段末 1.67／2M）。2026-09-22 02:00 UTC 為未收滿時段（至 02:08 共 9 筆），故不採用。近 180 筆最大 1.67（最先見於 2026-09-22 01:00 UTC；標籤 2M；近 180 筆窗自 23:09 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.67（01:00 UTC；標籤 2M）。窗起點 2026-09-21 20:11 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (01:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 01:00 UTC is 1.67/2M; the trailing 02:00 hour on 22 September is incomplete (9 samples to 02:08) and unused.
